name: Bedrock Gateway + Cost Controls
summary: Exposes Bedrock LLM invocation through an API Gateway + Lambda gateway, with DynamoDB cost tracking and S3 invocation logging plus cost guardrails.

name: Self-Hosted LLM on EKS
summary: Stands up an EKS cluster with GPU node groups and addons for self-hosted model serving, fronted by an ALB and backed by ECR, S3 model weights and KMS.

name: SageMaker Endpoint
summary: Deploys a SageMaker real-time inference endpoint inside a VPC with S3 model artifacts and a Lambda invoker.

name: Prompt Management Service
summary: A prompt versioning service built on DynamoDB, Lambda and API Gateway for managing and serving versioned prompts.

name: Batch Inference Pipeline
summary: Runs SageMaker Batch Transform inference orchestrated by Step Functions with S3 input/output and a Lambda trigger.

name: RAG Pipeline
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation flow with S3 document storage, Bedrock embeddings, an OpenSearch vector store, ingestion and query Lambdas behind API Gateway, and a DynamoDB context store.

name: Vector Database
summary: OpenSearch Serverless vector store with KMS encryption and a Lambda admin handler for vector index management.

name: AI Safety + Guardrails
summary: Bedrock Guardrails with content filtering and audit logging for safe AI usage.

name: Agent Orchestration (SFN)
summary: Multi-step agent orchestration using Step Functions, Lambda orchestrator and worker, DynamoDB state store and S3 artifact store, fronted by API Gateway.

name: Temporal on EKS
summary: Temporal workflow engine deployed on EKS via Helm chart integration.

name: Feature Store
summary: SageMaker Feature Store providing offline and online feature storage.

name: Experiment Tracking
summary: MLflow experiment tracking on ECS/EKS with artifact storage.

name: Data Labeling Pipeline
summary: SageMaker Ground Truth annotation workflows for data labeling.

name: Model Registry
summary: SageMaker Model Registry with approval workflows for model governance.

name: A/B Testing for Models
summary: Traffic splitting and canary inference endpoints for A/B testing models.

name: ML Training Pipeline
summary: SageMaker Pipelines with training jobs and hyperparameter tuning, running in a VPC with KMS-encrypted S3 training data and model artifacts plus a SageMaker endpoint.

name: Fine-Tuning Pipeline
summary: SageMaker Training with custom containers and dataset management for model fine-tuning.

name: Model Monitoring
summary: SageMaker Model Monitor with drift detection and alerting.

name: Multi-Model Endpoint
summary: SageMaker multi-model serving with dynamic model loading.

name: Edge Inference
summary: SageMaker Neo and IoT Greengrass for edge model deployment and inference.

name: Serverless API + ETL
summary: Serverless API and ETL pipeline: API Gateway triggers an ingest Lambda that feeds an SQS work queue, a worker Lambda processes messages and writes to an S3 output bucket.

name: EKS Managed Cluster
summary: Managed EKS cluster with node groups across two subnets, a dedicated VPC, and security groups.

name: ECS Fargate + ALB
summary: ECS Fargate service behind an Application Load Balancer, with cluster, task definition, ECR repository, VPC, subnets and security groups.

name: Scheduled Batch Processing
summary: Scheduled batch processing driven by an EventBridge Scheduler that starts a Step Functions workflow invoking a worker Lambda that writes to S3.

name: Static Site + CDN + WAF
summary: Static website served from S3 via CloudFront with an ACM certificate, WAFv2 protection, and a CloudFront Function for URL rewriting.

name: Account Bootstrap
summary: Baseline account security: AWS Config recorder, Security Hub, GuardDuty, CloudTrail with KMS-encrypted S3 audit logs, Config Rules, Budgets, an SNS alert topic and a Secrets Manager secret.

name: Multi-Account Organization
summary: AWS Organizations with SCPs and centralized logging for multi-account governance.

name: Networking Hub-Spoke
summary: Hub-and-spoke network with a Transit Gateway connecting hub and spoke VPCs via attachments, plus Network Firewall and a NAT Gateway.

name: Aurora Serverless v2
summary: Aurora Serverless v2 RDS cluster fronted by an RDS Proxy, with KMS encryption, a Secrets Manager master password, VPC, subnets and security group.

name: MSK Kafka
summary: Amazon MSK Kafka cluster with a custom MSK configuration across three subnets, KMS encryption, and an S3 logs bucket.

name: Data Lake
summary: Data lake with a Glue Data Catalog, Glue ETL job and crawler, Athena workgroup, and KMS-encrypted raw/processed S3 buckets in a VPC.

name: ElastiCache Redis
summary: ElastiCache Redis cluster with encryption and auth in a VPC, plus a Lambda cache reader.

name: OTel Observability Stack
summary: OpenTelemetry observability stack via ECS/EKS deployments plus managed observability services.

name: Centralized Logging
summary: Centralized logging with Kinesis Firehose feeding an OpenSearch domain, CloudWatch Logs subscription filters, KMS encryption, an SNS alert topic and S3 backup, in a VPC.

name: WAF + Shield + Secrets
summary: Edge protection with WAFv2 and an ACM certificate on a CloudFront distribution fronting an S3 origin, plus KMS and a Secrets Manager secret.

name: GitHub Actions + OIDC
summary: CI/CD template with a GitHub OIDC provider and IAM roles for GitHub Actions.

name: CodePipeline
summary: AWS CodePipeline with CodeBuild and deployment stages.

name: Cost Optimization
summary: Cost controls with Budgets and cost alerts via SNS, an AWS Config Rules encryption check, a remediation Lambda, and an S3 cost reports bucket.
